Expect the first number to be low; that is the honest starting line. Only after that number exists does 'how to raise it' (argument-aware rules per tool, or a YELLOW review band fed by a classifier) become a design question worth asking.

op22_spec.jtbd: Given a gate-able moral (idiom + precise statement + tao-proverb id) and a labeled instance set swept from decision-receipts/NFTT (failures-to-catch + passes-to-allow), forge the CHEAPEST predicate that separates them (grep < lint < schema < assert), emit its insertion point (e.g. PreToolUse on the irreversible class), and prove fails-on-bad AND passes-on-good, OR REFUSE with 'no mechanical signature, stays a proverb'. The refusal is a first-class, celebrated output, not an error.
orthogonal_echoes: 1. Triage is non-negotiable and upstream (compiler-semantics / immune-epitope / bright-line-vs-totality / cleavable-vs-amorphous = same split, four languages). The refusal for judgment-only morals is the most important output; a manufactured gate for one is the whole failure mode (forbidden-fruit over-claim).
2. OP22 operationalizes, does not invent: the moral pre-exists; binding it to a predicate keeps the output verifiable against the source, not a hallucinated rule.
3. The gate is a BOUNDARY forged from labeled instances, not a definition: needs both failure and pass examples, re-deriving fails-on-bad AND passes-on-good from first principles.
4. The gate carries its firing point (Nyquist/surveillance/insertion): emit the predicate AND where it runs, or a correct rule fires too late.
op22_spec.saturation_note: Echoes stabilized ~trip 8; further framings add metaphors not echoes. Saturation is the stop signal, not a fixed count.

new_echoes_from_transform: 5. Gates are AGENT-SPECIFIC: forged from and valid only against the agent's OWN failure corpus (the night-moves sweep of this agent's receipts), not a generic ruleset. A gate built from someone else's failures has no purchase on this agent's real failure modes.

6. Gates accrete into a SKELETON with a load-bearing spine: op20's real job is not only clustering morals into families but finding which gates are load-bearing (the spine) vs peripheral. The spine is the gravity well that pulls new gates toward it. op22_spec.method_principle: Write drunk, edit sober (Hemingway). OP22's own generation is this two-pass: DRUNK = the REBUS/relaxed-prior divergent pass that surfaces candidate gates (where new echoes come from); SOBER = the verification pass that keeps only fails-on-bad AND passes-on-good and refuses judgment-only morals. The sober edit is non-negotiable; the drunk write is non-optional (pure sober never reaches the agent-specific-corpus or skeleton echoes). The idiom is itself a gate-able principle for any generate-then-verify pipeline.

rag_to_rom_graduation_criterion.frame: RAG = responsive (retrieve, re-derive per context, slow, self-freshening) = the WELL. ROM-etched = reflexive (prepaid deliberation, fires straight through, fast+blind) = the POND. The etch is reflex formation / myelination.
criteria: (1) EARNED through the gate: proven fails-on-bad AND passes-on-good. Etching before proof = a hallucination hardwired, strictly worse than RAG (which re-checks).

(2) NON-DECAYING: only true invariants etch (they do not rot). Context-dependent heuristics STAY RAG where they get re-checked; etching a decaying heuristic = a reflex that fires the wrong thing fast into a changed context.
rag_to_rom_graduation_criterion.governance: One-way doors stay RESPONSIVE forever; a reflex at an irreversible threshold is the rogue operator by definition. The ONLY permitted reflex at a cliff is the one whose action is 'halt and hand control back to responsive' (the tool-layer deny is exactly this: reflexively refuse to be reflexive at the door). Reflexify freely everywhere reversible + invariant.

isolation_by_reversibility: The etch demands a declared write-lock + serializable cut (WRITE-LOCK ROM primitive; Yoav store), but LOCALIZED to the etch, never global. Global serializability stops the world = the DB version of never giving the agent leash. Reversible region -> optimistic concurrency, merge-on-conflict (git). Irreversible/etch -> write-lock + serializable. Same gravity invariant at three layers: agent autonomy, DB isolation, canon writes -- free where reversible, locked where not.
pond_definition: Not a trip count -- a PERCOLATION/connectivity threshold: well becomes pond when the gate-skeleton is cross-linked densely enough that op20's folksonomy seats a NEW moral onto the spine without a fresh op22 divergence pass. Run-dependent; no number claimed (claiming one = fabrication). The etch is itself a one-way door, so pond-formation is subject to its own invariant (short leash, falsify first, do not etch on momentum): the gravity well is governed by its own gravity.

progression_ladder.principle: Funny money until a reflexive gut feel is earned and measured; then a low-limit table; then progressively derisk. Graduation is earned by calibration, never bought.
tiers: T0 chips: play money only (live now in case 001)
T1 low-limit table: unlocks only after a sustained calibration bar over a minimum claim count (thresholds set from real T0 data, not asserted now); small hard cap per game
T2 raised limits: unlocks only if calibration holds at T1 over a second window; caps rise stepwise, never jump
guardrails_not_exit_liquidity: demotion is automatic: calibration drops below the bar, the tier drops with it
hard loss limit per day/week plus a cooldown after a loss streak
counterparty transparency: the player always sees who is on the other side; the house never takes the other side
no buying a tier: money cannot substitute for calibration
late-entry guard: no staking after the evidence reveal or on a market whose outcome is already public

jtbd: The vox step sits BETWEEN /recoil-close and the recoil report: pipeline recoil-prep > call > recoil-close (transcript pulled, ex-ante receipt scored, output WITHHELD from Zach) > VOX (blind capture, then commit-reveal) > report. Blind capture first: five prompts, two minutes, voice or text, answered before Zach sees the scored close, so the transcript cannot anchor his recall: (1) where did the energy turn (minute, moment, quote); (2) expected vs happened (one line); (3) what surprised you (inflection, pause, laughter, interruption, latency); (4) energized or drained, at which part; (5) what must be verified, plus 0-100 confidence. Commit: timestamp and hash the answers. Reveal: show the scored close. Reconcile: for each prompt mark AGREE, DIVERGE or UNMATCHED against the transcript-derived findings; DIVERGE is flagged for human attention and never auto-resolved. Outputs: OBSERVATION atoms in the counterpart universe (type observation, speaker Zach, grade O, source 'Zach debrief <timestamp>'); optional felt_sense field in tools/recoil-report/schema/report.schema.json; a 'Felt sense vs transcript' block in the report. jtbd: Idea, held, in two layers. (1) Wallet attestations for voting: a vote on a Farcaster poll is a signed attestation from a wallet that is verified to a FID, so anyone can recompute the tally from a read node and the attestations. (2) Non-casino conditional money: assurance contracts and refundable deposits (pledges released to a stated purpose only if a threshold or vote passes, refunded otherwise). No participant is paid out of other participants' losses.
status_note: HELD by default: out of scope for the 7-day bounty entry. Captured 2026-10-17 from Zach: conditional smart-wallet programming tied to a poll outcome, then narrowed to wallet-based attestations for voting and non-casino retail use. Order if ever pursued: attestation-only voting first (no money; fits as a receipt resolver kind), then testnet assurance contracts. Avoid outcome-contingent payouts between participants (the casino shape). Real money raises legal questions (gambling, securities, money transmission) that need counsel; not legal advice. Claude does not execute transfers or trades.
